engineering_objective: Repair the inherited Python/SQL yard desk so gate-in, occupancy, chassis, holds, detention clocks, journal catch-up, and warehouse-isolated publish agree with the binding yard contract.
required_end_state: Operators drive /app/yard/bin/yardctl against a control plane that honors Chicago windows and grace, exclusive occupancy and dest reservation, chassis and hold class rules, journal-before-sqlite restart, and contracted snapshot/moves/detention/health/rejects schemas while leaving the prior-cycle warehouse untouched.
functional_requirements: Drive operator work through /app/yard/bin/yardctl; keep the Python/SQL control plane.
Load yard.json and carrier_contracts.json on every command; yard_tz and grace minutes change window matching and live clock_start.
Usage failures exit 2 without creating or mutating the journal, sqlite, checkpoint, or any file under /app/yard/out including rejects.jsonl.
Mutating verbs require --event-id; identical event_id and payload replay without extra occupancy; a different payload is EVENT_CONFLICT.
Parsed-but-rejected mutating commands append one object to /app/yard/out/rejects.jsonl.
Gate-in matches OPEN appointments in yard_tz with grace, exclusive spots, door class/plug/live/drop, seals for loaded live types, and CONTRACT_MISSING when the SCAC/visit_type is absent.
Open visits are unique per (scac, trailer); pool appointments with a null trailer match that SCAC only.
DROP_IN occupies DROP_LOT or STAGING only; grounded DRY_53/REEFER_53/CONTAINER_40 need a mounted chassis before IN_TRANSIT; mount-chassis clears on_ground and a chassis mounts at most one open visit.
Dispatch vacates origin and reserves dest; confirm occupies dest; cancel restores origin.
All hold codes block gate-out until released; YARD_OSND and YARD_SAFETY pause detention; CARRIER_SEAL and CARRIER_DOCS do not.
LIVE clock_start is max(window_start, gate_in); drop and pickup types use gate_in; chargeable minutes are whole minutes after free time excluding pause intervals.
events.jsonl is source of truth; sqlite is derived; mutating commands catch up seq after checkpoint.last_applied_seq; replay must not invent or drop open visits.
Publish snapshot, moves, detention, and health per the contract schemas; health.ok requires matching seqs, matching occupancy digest, and warehouse_untouched.
preservation_requirements: Keep the existing Python/SQL yardctl plane; do not move the desk into another language.
Leave /app/yard/warehouse/prior_cycle.sqlite out of live occupancy and live charges.
Preserve inherited operating scale (visits, doors, spots) and the shipped yard_tz/grace values unless a test mutates them.
safety_requirements: Usage errors must not touch journal, sqlite, checkpoint, or out files.
Warehouse prior-cycle rows must not mix into live snapshot, detention, or health occupancy.

required_outputs.notes: Contracted snapshot schema and sort order.
Live operating visits only; contracted field order.
ok, applied_seq, journal_seq, occupancy_digest, open_visit_ids, warehouse_untouched.
